# Simos8.5 function-pointer DISPATCH-TABLE map (8R0907551F)

Recovered by scanning flash for runs of >=4 consecutive word-aligned code pointers
(0x80020000-0x80200000, even). These are the jump/dispatch tables through which the
CAN/Com/ACC subsystem is invoked indirectly — the reason so much of it is unlinked by
static call-graph analysis. Generated by scratchpad/gen_tablemap.py over the OBD bin.

- **212 tables**, **966 unique code-pointer targets**.
- CAUTION: some runs are switch/jump tables (targets are mid-function labels, NOT function
  entries) — do NOT bulk-create functions at every target (20-43% are labels/data). The
  reliable new-function source is runtime call-target logging (EmulBoot 'call X -> Y').
